methodology: Fixed optimized non-debuggable independent PoC;3 accounts,4 pages,2 environment/runtime groups;fresh x86_64 Google APIs VMs with4096MiB configured RAM and actual2 logical CPUs.

Two HTTP periodic payload cadences500ms and5000ms; underlying500ms dispatch remains, real input/click/scroll and coalesced latest-state delivery bypass cadence throttling. This is observer overhead calibration, not an App code optimization.

Every Home/screen-off/forced-Doze window lasts180 actual host seconds, with30-second CPU windows and approximately60-second PSS observations. Functional checks reset to500ms and confirm actual page acknowledgement before proceeding.

PSS category values are meminfo App Summary categories, not retained-object heap traces; all recorded package-process summaries were available. System is the reported per-process summary bucket, not total system memory.
Equal unsigned APK and R8 mapping digests per API demonstrate fixed App bytes. Signed APK digests differ because each arm uses a disposable CI certificate, independently attested on device.
All page/model/environment/cookie/crypto/conflict/recovery/no-submit assertions remain. No forced GC, process trimming, App battery whitelist or turning off recovery was used.

Single matched runs; compare cadence effect within the same API, not a universal percentage or physical hardware prediction. Independent HTTP started counters can be stale during blocked Doze and are not exact wire-throughput counts.
findings: High-frequency full HTTP observation materially affects measured idle CPU. In this fixed synthetic workload, reducing payload cadence10x changed Home CPU from11.4329 to2.3019% one core on API28 and2.5615 to0.5117% on API35, without changing App bytes.
All idle windows showed zero new recovery capture messages and zero page-record writes. These observations do not support continuous encrypted page autosave as the main idle-work explanation.

API28 high-cadence PSS growth concentrated in content-process Private Other; Java Heap and Native Heap summary buckets did not grow similarly. Low-cadence windows showed substantially smaller or declining PSS.
Private Other is a coarse measured category. This round did not establish an allocator/object-level cause, memory leak, JS heap attribution or permanent memory bound.
App-level hot-path benefits from the previous round remain separately supported; observer cadence reduction must not be counted again as App performance improvement.
remainingGates: No current formal System WebView client or real ChatGPT measurement.
arm64/OEM physical-device, multi-hour/overnight and severe OS-memory-pressure validation remain pending.
If further memory attribution is required, inspect content-process mappings/heap lifetime under a controlled workload; this round does not authorize formal migration or changing user sessions.
